statements.t: During the quarter ended October 4, 2026, we had consolidated net sales of $366.7 million, up 0.6% compared to $364.5 million in the third quarter last year as favorable prices were partially offset by lower sales volume and the deferral of certain retail market segment renovation projects into future periods.
Based on our third quarter and year to date 2026 results, we anticipate revenue growth for fiscal year 2026 compared to the prior year comparable period.
We also anticipate that our fourth quarter 2026 will be impacted by higher input costs amid increased global macroeconomic uncertainty.

With our ongoing investments in innovation, productivity, and operational efficiency, we remain confident in our ability to drive growth, expand margins, and create value for our stakeholders,” continued Hurd.
We are reaffirming our full-year earnings outlook and remain confident in the strength of our business.
